The best PS5 games on PS Plus

If you've got a PS5, PS Plus Extra is the cheapest way to see what it can do. These are our ten favourite games in the catalogue that you can only play on PS5, from Sony's biggest exclusives to a couple of smaller games you might have missed. Each one says what it's like and roughly how long the main story takes. The full list of PS5-only games follows.

What counts as a PS5 game

This list counts games in the Extra catalogue that you can only play on PS5. Games that also come in a PS4 version are left out, even if the PS5 version runs better, so everything here is built for the newer console, often with fast loading and the DualSense controller's haptics and adaptive triggers.

Some of these games are also on PC, but on PlayStation they're PS5 only. The full list includes every PS5-only game in the catalogue.

1

Demon's Souls

Action RPG · PS5 · Metascore 92 · about 24 h main story

A from-the-ground-up remake of the game that started the Souls series, and one of the best-looking games on the console. It's tough and atmospheric, and its haunted kingdom of Boletaria rewards patience.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

Marvel's Spider-Man 2

Open-world action · PS5 · Metascore 90 · about 17 h main story

Peter Parker and Miles Morales share the suit in a bigger New York, up against Kraven and the Venom symbiote. Swinging and gliding across the city at speed is the best showcase for the PS5's fast loading.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

The Last of Us Part I

Survival action · PS5 · Metascore 89 · about 14 h main story

A full PS5 remake of Joel and Ellie's journey across a ruined America. It's one of the great game stories, rebuilt with new animation and detail, and still devastating.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart

Platformer shooter · PS5 · Metascore 88 · about 11 h main story

Ratchet and a new hero, Rivet, jump between dimensions in an instant, whole worlds swapping in a blink. It's bright, funny and packed with daft weapons, and a great game to play with kids watching.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

Blue Prince

Puzzle adventure · PS5 · Metascore 92 · about 18 h main story

You inherit a mansion whose rooms change every day: each time you open a door, you choose what room lies behind it. Working out its secrets is one of the most satisfying puzzles in years.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

Death Stranding 2: On the Beach

Open-world adventure · PS5 · Metascore 89 · about 35 h main story

Sam Porter Bridges sets out across Mexico and Australia to reconnect a broken world one delivery at a time. Hideo Kojima's strange, ambitious sequel is one of the most striking games on the console.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Returnal

Roguelike shooter · PS5 · Metascore 86 · about 19 h main story

A space pilot crash-lands on a hostile alien planet and relives the same run every time she dies. It's a fast, intense shooter where the controller's feedback does a lot of the talking, and every run teaches you something.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade

Action RPG · PS5 · Metascore 89 · 93% recommend on OpenCritic · about 32 h main story

A lavish reimagining of the most famous Final Fantasy, set entirely in the city of Midgar, with combat that mixes real-time action and tactical pauses. This version adds a bonus chapter starring Yuffie.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Helldivers 2

Co-op shooter · PS5 · Metascore 82 · about 33 h main story

You and up to three friends drop onto alien planets to spread “managed democracy” for Super Earth, with friendly fire always on and orbital strikes on call. It's chaotic, very funny and best with a squad.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Sword of the Sea

Exploration adventure · PS5 · Metascore 88 · about 2.7 h main story

You surf a hoverboard across sand that turns to water as you bring a dead world back to life. It's short, gorgeous and pure joy to move through, from the makers of Journey and Abzû.

Questions

What's the best PS5 game on PS Plus?

Among PS5-only games, Demon's Souls and Blue Prince share the top Metascore at 92. For something that shows off the console, Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart or Marvel's Spider-Man 2.

Do I need PS Plus Extra for these?

Yes. They're in the Extra catalogue, which also comes with Premium. Essential only includes the monthly games.

Why isn't God of War Ragnarök on this list?

It's in the catalogue, but it also has a PS4 version, so it's not PS5-only. It's still one of the best games on PS Plus.

Can I play PS4 games from PS Plus on PS5?

Yes, almost all PS4 games in the catalogue play on PS5.

Are there short PS5 games on PS Plus?

Sword of the Sea takes about 3 hours, and Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart about 11. Our short games list has more.
